Use Sample AI with the Anthropic SDK

Sample AI offers an Anthropic-compatible endpoint, so tools built on the Anthropic Messages API work unchanged.

export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.sample-ai.example/anthropic
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$SAMPLE_API_KEY
curl https://api.sample-ai.example/anthropic/v1/messages \
  -H "x-api-key: $SAMPLE_API_KEY" \
  -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" \
  -d '{"model": "sample-m2", "max_tokens": 1024, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]}'

Supported models: sample-m2, sample-m2-mini.
